movers-film-star.fact: Some film stars started acting when they were children.

movers-fine.definition: good enough; okay and not a problem
movers-fine.hint: Say "I am fine" when someone asks how you feel.
movers-fine.fact: Fine weather means sunny skies and gentle wind.

movers-first.definition: coming before all others; number one in order
movers-first.definitionVi: đầu tiên, số một trong thứ tự
movers-first.hint: Who crossed the finish line first?
movers-first.fact: The first day of school is exciting for many children.

movers-fish.definition: to try to catch fish with a rod and line
movers-fish.definitionVi: câu cá bằng cần và dây
movers-fish.hint: Sit quietly by the lake when you fish.
movers-fish.fact: Some people fish in the sea from a small boat.

movers-fix.definition: to repair something that is broken or not working
movers-fix.definitionVi: sửa chữa cái gì đó bị hỏng
movers-fix.hint: Dad can fix the broken chair with glue.
movers-fix.fact: Engineers fix bridges and roads to keep them safe.

movers-forest.definition: a large area covered with many trees
movers-forest.definitionVi: rừng, nơi có rất nhiều cây
movers-forest.hint: Walk quietly in the forest and listen for birds.
movers-forest.fact: Forests are home to deer, foxes and many insects.

movers-frightened.definition: feeling very scared because of something sudden
movers-frightened.definitionVi: sợ hãi, hoảng sợ vì điều bất ngờ
movers-frightened.hint: Thunder can make small dogs feel frightened.
movers-frightened.fact: Hugging someone you trust helps when you feel frightened.

movers-funfair.definition: an outdoor place with rides, games and sweet treats
movers-funfair.definitionVi: hội chợ vui chơi với trò chơi và đồ ngọt
movers-funfair.hint: Win a teddy at the funfair ring-toss game.
movers-funfair.fact: Funfairs often have bright lights and merry-go-rounds.
